text:
Anya P: Quick design review — noticed the p95 card jitter when sampling is low. Proposal: add a small-range smoothing (moving average over 3 buckets) and a 'sampling info' affordance in the tooltip. Thoughts?
Julian K: Agree re: jitter. Concern: smoothing could hide real regressions. Maybe only apply smoothing when sampling < 10 samples/min and show an inline badge "low sample".
Tara L: For implementation, we can do a client-side moving average + a server flag. Moving average is cheap, but we need to surface raw data toggle so power users can disable smoothing.
Mike C: Data note: across prod routes, jitter tends to spike when sample rate < 0.5%. Quick query I ran: `SELECT count(*) FROM traces WHERE sampled = 1 GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 60` — median per-minute sampled traces drops below 10 on several routes.
Anya P: Good call on a raw toggle. UX idea: put a three-dot menu on the p95 card with "Smoothing: on/off" and an info tooltip: "Smoothing reduces short-term volatility when sample sizes are low; it may mask short regressions."
Samira R: Accessibility nits: the toggle must be keyboard operable (aria-pressed) and announce state changes via a polite live region. The "low sample" badge needs 4.5:1 contrast and an aria-label that reads sample count and threshold.
Julian K: Also thinking about the heatmap: add a faint density overlay (0–100%) behind the heatmap buckets so users can visually correlate p95 spikes with sampling density. Hover should read out bucket sample-count and percentile values.
Tara L: Implementation note: density overlay is a second canvas layer; we can reuse the existing bucket aggregation API but will need an endpoint that returns sample_count per bucket. I'll sketch perf implications.
Anya P: Draft microcopy for badge/tooltip: "Low sample — fewer than 10 sampled traces/min; percentiles may be unreliable." Good?
Samira R: Slight tweak for SR: "Low sample — fewer than 10 sampled traces per minute. Percentile estimates may be unreliable." Use aria-describedby to point at this text for screen readers.
Mike C: +1 to showing sample-rate % in the tooltip as well (e.g., "Sample rate: 0.3% (8 traces/min)"). That helps debugging.
Julian K: I'll mock a compact badge (left of the p95 value) + the dropdown states (smoothing on/off/auto) in Figma and post link shortly. The auto state = smoothing only when samples < threshold.
Tara L: Quick feasibility: prototype for p95 smoothing + badge ~ 2-3d. Heatmap density overlay ~ 2d to prototype, 3-4d to polish (accessibility, legend, edge cases).
Anya P: Sounds reasonable. Let's ship as an experiment behind a feature flag and evaluate on two low-sample routes for 2 weeks.
DevBot: design-preview deployed: https://preview.redwood/ux/1766112233 — p95 card now has "Smoothing" dropdown and "Low sample" badge (staging only).
Julian K: Posted Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/p95-smoothing-dropdown — cc @Tara L @Samira R
Tara L: I'll pick this up after current bugfix sprint. Will add an API shape for per-bucket sample counts in the PR description.
Anya P: Thanks all. Action items: Julian — final mock + copy; Tara — engineering estimate + API shape; Samira — a11y checks + exact aria text; Mike — pick two routes and share baseline metrics. I'll create the feature flag ticket. :thumbsup:
Mike C: I'll share sample-rate plots and route list by EOD.
Samira R: I'll draft the screen-reader text and post here for quick review.
Julian K: Quick microcopy alternative for tooltip: "Smoothing reduces short-term volatility for low-sample signals. Toggle off to see raw percentiles."
Anya P: Love it. We'll iterate after the experiment.
